            Begin
                Begin Label
                    Left =120
                    Top =60

                    Height =360
                    Name ="lblTitle"
                    Caption ="Invoice"
                End
            End
        End
        Begin BreakHeader
            Height =600
            Name ="GroupHeader0"
            Begin
                Begin TextBox
                    Left =120
                    Top =120
                    Width =2400
                    Height =300
                    Name ="txtOrder"
                    ControlSource ="=\"Order \" & [OrderNo]"
                End
            End
        End
        Begin Section
            Height =360
            Name ="Detail"
            Begin
                Begin TextBox
                    Left =120

                    Name ="txtCustomerLabel"
                    ControlSource ="CustomerLabel"
                End
            End
        End
        Begin PageFooter
            Height =360
            Name ="PageFooterSection"
        End
    End
End
